entities.summary: Devin Marquese Bush Jr. is an American professional football linebacker for the Chicago Bears of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Michigan Wolverines, twice earning All-American honors, and was selected by the Pittsburgh Steelers in the first round of the 2019 NFL draft.
